title: Officials endorse a multi-generational crash retrieval program
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Officials endorse a multi-generational crash retrieval program, about decades-long at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: also seen past directors of the CIA, congressmen and women, and whistleblowers across agencies endorsing the existence of a decades-long, multi-generational UFO crash retrieval and reverse engineering program.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that past directors of the CIA, the US spy agency, along with members of Congress and whistleblowers from several agencies, have backed the existence of a secret programme. According to Michels, this programme has run for decades and across generations, collecting crashed UFOs and trying to work out how they function so the technology can be copied. If true, it would mean the US government has held alien craft for a very long time.
